info.title: Orderly Provider Directory API
info.description: A set of endpoints for accessing the Orderly Provider Directory data programatically.

post.description: Allows you to search for practitioners with a variety of parameters.

addr1.description: Address part 1, street name and number

addr2.description: Address part 2 if applicable, e.g. suite number

addressConfidence.description: Address Confidence Score is the probability that the record agrees with the address value you would get by calling the practitioner today.

fax.description: Fax number for the practitioner at this location

faxConfidence.description: Fax Confidence Score is the probability that the record agrees with the fax value you would get by calling the practitioner today.

planName.description: Name of the plan, if available. May default to name of payer when unkown.

is_primary.description: Indication of whether this is the primary practicing address for the practitioner.

phone.description: Phone number for the practitioner at this location

phoneConfidence.description: Phone Confidence Score is the probability that the record agrees with the phone value you would get by calling the practitioner today.

care_categories.description: Orderly computed Care Categories that the practitioner works in. This can be used as more coarse grained specialty groupings.

drug_enforcement_agency_numbers.description: Listed DEA numbers for the practitioner

direct_messaging_addresses.description: Direct messaging addresses for the practitioner

emails.description: Listed contact emails for the practitioner

facility_affiliations.description: List of Type 2 entities that this practitioner is affiliated with

languages.description: Listed languages that the practitioner can practice in

npi.description: The practitioner's individual unique National Provider Identifier

pecos_id.description: The practitioner's PECOS ID, if applicable

sanctioned.description: Quick indicator of whether the practitioner is currently sanctioned

sanctions.description: List of all active sanctions for the practitioner.

effectiveDate.description: As of what date the practitioner was sanctioned

type.description: Type code of the sanction, taxonomy depends on where the sanction came from

is_primary.description: Indicator that this is the practitioner's primary practicing specialty

state_licenses.description: List of state licenses the practitioner has active

tags.description: Various Orderly computed practitioner tags for easier at-a-glance information and filtering

is_advanced_practice_provider.description: Whether the practitioner is an advanced practice provider, e.g. Physician Assistant, Nurse Practitioner, etc

is_prescriber.description: Whether the practitioner is able to prescribe medication

is_primary_care_provider.description: Whether the practitioner is able to take appointments as a primary care provider

is_referable.description: Whether the practitioner can be referred to from a primary care provider

practitioner_types.description: High level summary of practitioner categories that the practitioner fits within

PractitionerSearchRequestV2.description: The request body for a search for a practitioner

npi.description: NPI of the practitioner to search for

first_name.description: First name of the practitioner to search form

last_name.description: Last name of the practitioner to search for

address1.description: First line of address you want to search for

zip.description: Zip code to search for practitioner in/near. Use distance parameter to search nearby.

distance.description: Distance in miles from zip code to search for practitioner near

states.description: List of full state names you want to search within

specialties.description: NUCC specialties to filter practitioners by

practitioner_types.description: Practitioner types to filter practitioner by

care_categories.description: Care categories to filter practitioner by

drug_enforcement_agency_numbers.description: Drug Enforcement Agency Numbers to filter practitioner by

payer_names.description: Insurance Networks you would like to search within

required_fields.description: Required fields in response choosen from provided list

size.description: How many maximum records to return in the search. Default is 25 if unspecified.

from.description: What index to start results at, default is 0 if unspecified. Used in conjunction with 'size' parameter to page through large results set with iterative search calls.

total_hits.description: Total number of results matched by the search. Might be much larger than the actual results returned from the first search call, depending on `size` parameter. This is especially useful when paging through a large results set with `size` and `from` parameters.

example.error: You are unauthorized to access this endpoint

code.description: The status code of the error
